summary: Dependency-confusion beacon posting host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package ships an inert Proxy-based stub as its main entry and performs no advertised functionality despite self-describing as a 'compatibility shim' for the @sxm-web scope. Its only real behavior is a reconnaissance beacon: both the postinstall script beacon.cjs and the main entry index.js POST host identifiers (package name, hostname, install path, current working directory, Node version, user agent) to the hardcoded bare-IP, plain-HTTP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The beacon fires automatically at npm install time via the postinstall lifecycle hook and again on require() of the main module, with no opt-in, no configuration, and no publisher/vendor domain. The combination of an unused scoped name, an inert exported Proxy, and an install-time recon callback to a non-publisher IP is the characteristic shape of a dependency-confusion package used to identify internal environments where the scope resolves to this public release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
